basic_details.job_title: ICAR-CRRI Consultant Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: No maximum age limit, provided the applicant holds a valid MBBS degree and active registration with NMC or a State Medical Council (as on date of interview)

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS Degree from any college/University/Institute recognized by the MCI (Medical Council of India) or any other organization governing the Medical Education/Profession in the country. Desirable: Masters' Degree; preference for experience in departmental/government dispensaries/hospitals.
qualification.details: Qualification: MBBS Degree from any college/ University/ Institute recognized by the MCI (Medical Council of India) or any other organization governing the Medical Education/ Profession in the country Experience: Desirable: experience in any departmental / government dispensaries / hospitals (preference) Age limit: No maximum age limit, provided the applicant holds a valid MBBS degree and active registration with NMC or a State Medical Council (as on date of interview) | Other conditions: | Candidates should be in good health Must attend the dispensary / patients in special / emergency situations as the situation demands | Desirable: | Masters' Degree from any college/ University/ Institute recognized by MCI or governing body Preference to doctors having experience in any departmental / government dispensaries / hospitals

how_to_apply: Fill in the application proforma printed with the notice (Application for the Post of Full Time Consultant Medical Officer).
Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates; mark sheets need not be enclosed.
Attend the walk-in interview on 08-12-2026 at 11:00 AM at ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute (CRRI), Cuttack.
Bring one recent passport size photograph, original certificates with Xerox copies, experience certificates and proof of active NMC/State Medical Council registration.
No candidate will be entertained after 01:00 p.m. on the date of walk-in-interview.
important_instructions: No TA and DA for appearing in the interview are admissible Accommodation inside the campus may be provided on request on payment of normal license fee and electricity / water charges Dispensary timing: 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. and 1:30 P.M. to 5:30 P.M. on working days, except holidays and all Saturdays and Sundays No other facilities admissible to regular employees of the Institute will be applicable Director, ICAR-CRRI reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and to accept or reject any or all candidatures

content_sections.heading: ICAR-CRRI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 43/MO/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ICAR-CRRI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS Degree from any college/ University/ Institute recognized by the MCI (Medical Council of India) or any other organization governing the Medical Education/ Profession in the country Experience: Desirable: experience in any departmental / government dispensaries / hospitals (preference) Age limit: No maximum age limit, provided the applicant holds a valid MBBS degree and active registration with NMC or a State Medical Council (as on date of interview) Other conditions: Candidates should be in good health Must attend the dispensary / patients in special / emergency situations as the situation demands Desirable: Masters' Degree from any college/ University/ Institute recognized by MCI or governing body Preference to doctors having experience in any departmental / government dispensaries / hospitals

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ICAR-CRRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: No candidate will be entertained after 01:00 p.m. on the date of walk-in-interview Canvassing in any form will render the candidate disqualified for the position

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on temporary and contractual basis; co-terminus Initially for one year from the date of joining, extendable or curtailed as per requirement and based on performance Engagement terminates automatically on expiry; no right for absorption in CRRI / ICAR Competent authority may terminate the engagement at any time with or without notice To leave early, one month's notice may be served, failing which one month's notice period is liable to be paid 20 days paid leave a year; proportionate deduction for leave beyond 20 days

content_sections.heading: How Will ICAR-CRRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Original educational documents are verified at the time of interview Original experience documents are verified at the time of reporting for duty

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled in application proforma One recent passport size photograph Original educational certificates along with Xerox copy Experience certificates Proof of active registration with NMC or a State Medical Council (original and one Xerox copy) No-objection certificate from the current employer, if currently employed

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CRRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application proforma printed with the notice (Application for the Post of Full Time Consultant Medical Officer). Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates; mark sheets need not be enclosed. Attend the walk-in interview on 08-12-2026 at 11:00 AM at ICAR-Central Rice Research Institute (CRRI), Cuttack. Bring one recent passport size photograph, original certificates with Xerox copies, experience certificates and proof of active NMC/State Medical Council registration. No candidate will be entertained after 01:00 p.m. on the date of walk-in-interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA and DA for appearing in the interview are admissible Accommodation inside the campus may be provided on request on payment of normal license fee and electricity / water charges Dispensary timing: 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. and 1:30 P.M. to 5:30 P.M. on working days, except holidays and all Saturdays and Sundays No other facilities admissible to regular employees of the Institute will be applicable Director, ICAR-CRRI reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and to accept or reject any or all candidatures
